thread:
customer-liz: Hey team, security wants EU-only processing for a 4-week POC. Needs subprocessor list, BYOK (HSM) option, and a price uplift if we pin to eu-west and disable cross-region failover.

sam (AE): Looping SE + Security. Quick Qs: can they accept Dedicated or must it be hosted?

ira (SE): Dedicated or Private required for full HSM. Hosted pinned -> regional cache but limited BYOK. Config we use for POC:
```
routing: pinned
region: eu-west-1
failover: disabled
cache_scope: regional
```

anya (Security): Subprocessors published: https://redwood.ai/legal/subprocessors. BYOK via HSM supported on Private; Dedicated requires onboarding + key-access addendum. We can keep logs and KV cache scoped to EU for the POC.

customer-liz: HSM preferred. Can you send checklist and estimate on price delta? DR allowed only with written approval.

mike (Legal): We can draft a short addendum for no-failover with an emergency clause that requires written approval. Need RTO/RPO and SecOps contacts.

sam (AE): Ballpark: pinned-dedicated ~ +35% over hosted. POC discount possible. Action items: @ira send BYOK checklist and infra cost for 50 qps, @anya share subprocessors snapshot, @mike draft addendum. Kickoff tomorrow 10:00 CET.
